pairs.target: dé mǎ huílái de shíhòu , tǎ wéi méiyǒu zài chēpéng děng . búshì wàng le .
pairs.english: When Dema returned, Tavi was not waiting at the cart shed. He had not forgotten.
pairs.hanzi:
德玛回来的时候，塔维没有在车棚等。
不是忘了。

pairs.target: tā liǎngtiān qián tiānhēi cái huí tóng jiē , dìèrtiān jiāowán biǎo , tīngshuō cèzhàn de chē yào dào wǔhòu , biàn tóng yīwén yuē hǎo chīguòfàn zài qù .
pairs.english: He had reached Copperstep after dark two days earlier, handed in his sheets the next day, and heard the station cart was due in the afternoon; he and Iven had agreed to go after lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 他两天前天黑才回铜阶，第二天交完表，听说测站的车要到午后，便同伊文约好吃过饭再去。

pairs.target: jiéguǒ gāngshèng wán dìyīwǎn tāng , ménwài jiù yǒurén wèn , shuí zài děng yìzhī dònghuài de láng .
pairs.english: But just after he filled his first soup bowl, someone outside asked who was waiting for a frozen wolf.
pairs.hanzi: 结果刚盛完第一碗汤，门外就有人问，谁在等一只冻坏的狼。

pairs.target: dé mǎ zhàn zài ménkǒu , bāo bèi wāi le , bù láng jiá zài jiāndài lǐ , yìzhī ěrduo bùzhī ràng shénme yāpíng . tā shēnhòu nàge gāo gè xuéshēng bào zhe tú tǒng , liǎnshàng xiào , yǎnjīng què bì le yíbàn , xiàng suíshí néng zhàn zhe shuìguòqù .
pairs.english: Dema stood in the doorway, her bag crooked, the cloth wolf caught in its strap with one ear flattened. Behind her the tall student hugged a drawing tube, smiling with half-closed eyes as though ready to fall asleep standing.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛站在门口，包背歪了，布狼夹在肩带里，一只耳朵不知让什么压平。她身后那个高个学生抱着图筒，脸上笑，眼睛却闭了一半，像随时能站着睡过去。

pairs.target: pà wò dìyīgè pǎo qù jiē bāo , jiēdào shǒu , lìkè hǎn zěnme bǐ zǒu de shíhòu hái zhòng . dé mǎ shuō lǐmiàn zhuāng le shíèrtiān de fēng , bùxǔ suíbiàn fàng pǎo .
pairs.english: Pavo ran first to take the bag, then cried that it was heavier than when she left. Dema said it held twelve days of wind and must not be carelessly let loose.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃第一个跑去接包，接到手，立刻喊怎么比走的时候还重。德玛说里面装了十二天的风，不许随便放跑。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bāo gēxià , xiān kàn zhuōshàng nà wǎn tāng , wèn shìbushì tèyì liúgěi zìjǐ . yīwén shuō shì , tǎ wéi hái méi láidejí chāichuān , zìjǐ de wǎn yǐjīng bèi tuī dào tā miànqián .
pairs.english: She set down the bag, looked first at the soup and asked if it had been saved specially for her. Iven said yes; before Tavi could expose him, his bowl was already pushed before her.
pairs.hanzi:
她把包搁下，先看桌上那碗汤，问是不是特意留给自己。
伊文说是，塔维还没来得及拆穿，自己的碗已经被推到她面前。

pairs.target: nàwèi gāo gè xuéshēng jiào lí qí , dé mǎ tì tā jièshào wán , yòu bǔ yíjù , shuō tā liáng shù kuài , xiězì yě kuài , zìjǐ zài nàbiān shíèrtiān , zhìshǎo yǒu shítiān xiǎng bǎ tā de bǐ cáng qǐlái .
pairs.english: The tall student was Liqi. After introducing her, Dema added that she measured fast and wrote fast; for at least ten of those twelve days, Dema had wanted to hide her pen.
pairs.hanzi: 那位高个学生叫黎齐，德玛替她介绍完，又补一句，说她量数快，写字也快，自己在那边十二天，至少有十天想把她的笔藏起来。

pairs.target: lí qí yìbiān xiào yìbiān yáotóu , shuō shèngxià liǎngtiān shìyīnwèi xiàyǔ , bǐ jiègěi le dé mǎ .
pairs.english: Liqi laughed and shook her head: the other two days were rainy, and she had lent her pen to Dema.
pairs.hanzi: 黎齐一边笑一边摇头，说剩下两天是因为下雨，笔借给了德玛。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ yě lái , dàjiā jǐ dào chángzhuō yìtóu . dé mǎ tuō xià wàiyī , xiùzǐ lǐmiàn jiá zhe yípiàn gāncǎo , bá le bàntiān cái báchūlái .
pairs.english: Mira and Suyi joined them, everyone crowding one end of the long table. Dema removed her coat; a dry blade of grass caught inside her sleeve took ages to pull free.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡也来，大家挤到长桌一头。德玛脱下外衣，袖子里面夹着一片干草，拔了半天才拔出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn wūlǐ shìbushì yǒu fēng , tā shuō yǒu , dìyīwǎn chuāngzhǐ xiǎng le yíyè , nà zhī láng sài shàngqù gānghǎo , hòulái jiǎn lǎoshī gěi le tā yíkuài zhēn néng dǎngfēng de mùbǎn , cái bǎ láng jiùxiàlái .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether the room had been draughty. Yes: the window paper rattled all the first night, the wolf plugging it nicely, until Instructor Jian provided a board that really stopped wind and rescued the wolf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问屋里是不是有风，她说有，第一晚窗纸响了一夜，那只狼塞上去刚好，后来简老师给了她一块真能挡风的木板，才把狼救下来。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ chàdiǎn yòu jì yìzhī . tā shuō xìngkuī méi jì , cèzhàn méi rén tì láng kāifàn .
pairs.english: He said he had nearly posted another. Lucky he had not, she said; nobody at the station served meals to wolves.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己差点又寄一只。她说幸亏没寄，测站没人替狼开饭。

pairs.target: tāng hēwán , dé mǎ cái bǎ běnzi ná chūlái . búshì měiyè dōu yǒu zhěngqí de shù , jǐyè ràng yǔ dǎ dé fā zhòu , zhōngjiān yìzhāng háisī le bànjiǎo .
pairs.english: Only after the soup did Dema produce her notebook. Not every page held neat figures; rain had wrinkled several, and one had half a corner torn away.
pairs.hanzi: 汤喝完，德玛才把本子拿出来。不是每页都有整齐的数，几页让雨打得发皱，中间一张还撕了半角。

pairs.target: tā fān dào yíchù , gěi tǎ wéi kàn liǎngliè bùtóng de gāochā , shuō zìjǐ dìyītiān liáng de búshì tóngyígè diǎn .
pairs.english: She opened a page and showed Tavi two differing elevation columns, saying she had not measured the same point on the first day.
pairs.hanzi: 她翻到一处，给塔维看两列不同的高差，说自己第一天量的不是同一个点。

pairs.target: zhàn hòu yǒu pái jiù wū , yígè shàng le niánjì de nǚrén tíxǐng tā , nà kuài zuò jìhào de mùbǎn huì chāixiàlái shài . dé mǎ dāngshí zhī tīng jìnqù yíbàn , xiǎng gǎn zài lí qí qiántou zuò wán , hòulái fù liáng duìbúshàng , hái xiān yíxīn biérén pèng le chǐ .
pairs.english: Behind the station were old houses. An elderly woman warned her that the marked board was removed for drying. Dema had half-listened, wanting to finish before Liqi; when remeasurements failed to match, she first suspected somebody had moved the ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 站后有排旧屋，一个上了年纪的女人提醒她，那块做记号的木板会拆下来晒。德玛当时只听进去一半，想赶在黎齐前头做完，后来复量对不上，还先疑心别人碰了尺。

pairs.target: " nà hòulái ne ? " mǐlā wèn . " hòulái rénjiā bǎ bǎn názǒu le . " yìzhuō rén dōu xiào qǐlái , dé mǎ yě xiào , zhǐshì xiào dào yíbàn biàn dītóu , shuō zìjǐ nà shíhòu zhēn xiǎng zhǎo gè dìfāng zuàn .
pairs.english: “Then what?” Mira asked. “Then she took the board away.” The whole table laughed, Dema too, until she looked down midway and said she had truly wanted somewhere to hide.
pairs.hanzi:
“那后来呢？”米拉问。
“后来人家把板拿走了。”
一桌人都笑起来，德玛也笑，只是笑到一半便低头，说自己那时候真想找个地方钻。

pairs.target: tā qǐng nǚrén dài tā qù kàn , cái zhīdào bǎn hòutou háiyǒu yìtiáo gùdìng zài shí shàng de jiù xiàn , zhàn lǐ de biǎo rèn de shì nà yìtiáo , bú rèn shuí jīntiān bǎ xǐcài bǎn guà zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: She asked the woman to show her, and learned there was an old line fixed in stone behind the board; the station records referred to that, not wherever somebody hung a vegetable board that day.
pairs.hanzi: 她请女人带她去看，才知道板后头还有一条固定在石上的旧线，站里的表认的是那一条，不认谁今天把洗菜板挂在哪里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì yǐjīng jì dào jiāohuílái de tú shàng . tā diǎntóu , shuō gǎiguò le , lián zìjǐ zhàn zài nǎlǐ dōu zhòngxiě , búhuì ná dìyīzhāng qù gěi rén dìng lù .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether it was recorded on the returned drawing. She nodded: it was corrected, even her standing position rewritten; the first sheet would not be used to set anyone’s route.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是已经记到交回来的图上。她点头，说改过了，连自己站在哪里都重写，不会拿第一张去给人定路。

pairs.target: lí qí shuō tā nàtiān hòulái liáng dé hěn wǎn , zìjǐ děngdào fàn liáng , zhǐhǎo bǎ tā nà fèn xiān chī le yìkǒu . dé mǎ lìjí shuō búshì yìkǒu , zhuōshàng de rén yòu xiào , tā gāngcái suō zhù de jiānbǎng zhè cái mànmàn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Liqi said Dema had measured so late that her dinner cooled; she had been forced to take a bite of Dema’s portion. Dema immediately said it was more than a bite. The table laughed again, and her hunched shoulders slowly relaxed.
pairs.hanzi: 黎齐说她那天后来量得很晚，自己等到饭凉，只好把她那份先吃了一口。德玛立即说不是一口，桌上的人又笑，她刚才缩住的肩膀这才慢慢松开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi wèn tā shìbushì cóngcǐ bù jí le . guǒrán guò le yíhuìer , tā biàn shuō xiàcì háiyào shìshì néng bunéng bǐ lí qí kuài , zhǐshì bù gēn xǐcài bǎn bǐ le .
pairs.english: Tavi did not ask if she would never rush again. Sure enough, a little later she said she would still try to beat Liqi next time, just not race vegetable boards.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没问她是不是从此不急了。果然过了一会儿，她便说下次还要试试能不能比黎齐快，只是不跟洗菜板比了。

pairs.target: tā xiǎoshíhòu jiàn guò de shān bèi dēng yě zhǎodào le . nà jiān cóngqián fàng liáng de wūzi , rújīn yǒurén xiū chēlún hé dēngjià , yèlǐ gǎnhuó , mén jiù kāi dé wǎn .
pairs.english: She had found the lights behind the mountain from her childhood too. The former grain store now housed wheel and lamp-frame repairs, working late into the night.
pairs.hanzi: 她小时候见过的山背灯也找到了。那间从前放粮的屋子，如今有人修车轮和灯架，夜里赶活，门就开得晚。

pairs.target: dé mǎ qù jiè guò yícì xì cuò , wūlǐ de rén méi xiān wèn tā shì shuíjiā de háizi , dǎo wèn tā jièhuíqù huì buhuì hái .
pairs.english: Dema had borrowed a fine file there; the people did not first ask whose child she was, but whether she would return it.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛去借过一次细锉，屋里的人没先问她是谁家的孩子，倒问她借回去会不会还。

pairs.target: " hái le méiyǒu ? " yīwén wèn . tā yòng běnzi pāi tā yíxià , shuō hái le , hái tìrén dài guò yítàng fàn .
pairs.english: “Did you return it?” Iven asked. She tapped him with the notebook and said yes, and had brought them a meal too.
pairs.hanzi:
“还了没有？”伊文问。
她用本子拍他一下，说还了，还替人带过一趟饭。

pairs.target: nàlǐ de rén guòrìzi yě méi bǐ tāmen shǎo chī yídùn , tā xiǎoshíhòu gé zhe shān kàn dēng , zǒngyǐwéi tiānhēi yǐhòu hái bú shuì de rén , yídìng zài zuò shénme hěn liǎobùqǐ de shì .
pairs.english: People there lived their lives and ate just as often as they did. As a child looking across the mountain, she had always imagined anyone awake after dark must be doing something extraordinary.
pairs.hanzi: 那里的人过日子也没比他们少吃一顿，她小时候隔着山看灯，总以为天黑以后还不睡的人，一定在做什么很了不起的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ shí zhuó gāoqiáng de chuāng , zhōngyú jiǎng qǐ zìjǐ zhè jǐtiān de huó .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered Stonewash’s tall-wall windows and finally told them about his work.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起石濯高墙的窗，终于讲起自己这几天的活。

pairs.target: tā cóngzǎodàowǎn zhī kāi guò yícì jiāohuàn , mùpán què zhuāngmǎn le ; jiù péng de tiě yàng hòulái biàn le , zìjǐ gēnzhe tínggōng , nài lěi hái liú zhe chá . tā jiǎngqīng nǎxiē shì kànjiàn de , nǎxiē shì biérén gàosù tā de , méiyǒu bǎ huíchéng xiě biǎo dàngchéng bǎ zhá xiūhǎo .
pairs.english: He had made only one exchange all day, yet filled a tray; later the old shed’s iron samples changed, work stopped, and Nerai stayed to investigate. He distinguished what he had seen from what he had been told, never pretending that returning with records meant fixing the sluice.
pairs.hanzi: 他从早到晚只开过一次交换，木盘却装满了；旧棚的铁样后来变了，自己跟着停工，奈蕾还留着查。他讲清哪些是看见的，哪些是别人告诉他的，没有把回城写表当成把闸修好。

pairs.target: dé mǎ tīng wán , wèn tā nà dùn dāying yīwén de fàn suànbusuàn shù . tǎ wéi táitóu kàn yīwén , hòuzhě yìliǎn wúgū , shuō zìjǐ zhī gàosù guò mǐlā .
pairs.english: Dema asked whether his promised meal for Iven still counted. Tavi looked up at Iven, who looked innocent and said he had only told Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛听完，问他那顿答应伊文的饭算不算数。塔维抬头看伊文，后者一脸无辜，说自己只告诉过米拉。

pairs.target: sū yǐ jǔshǒu , shuō zìjǐ yòu gàosù le pà wò . pà wò shuō zìjǐ zhī wèn dé mǎ huílái de shíhòu , yuànbuyuànyì yìqǐ chī . tǎ wéi kànzhe zhè yìzhěng zhuō rén , zhōngyú míngbái yuánlái nà dùnfàn yǐjīng bǐ zìjǐ xiān chūlemén .
pairs.english: Suyi raised her hand and said she had told Pavo. Pavo said he only asked whether Dema would join them on her return. Looking around the whole table, Tavi realized the meal had travelled farther than he had.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡举手，说自己又告诉了帕沃。帕沃说自己只问德玛回来的时候，愿不愿意一起吃。塔维看着这一整桌人，终于明白原来那顿饭已经比自己先出了门。

pairs.target: tā shù le yíbiàn réntóu , shuō jīntiān xiān qiàn zhe , dé zhǎo gè wǎn dà xiē de dìfāng . dé mǎ jiāng bù láng fàngdào zhuōbiān , wèn zhège suànbusuàn .
pairs.english: He counted heads and said he owed them for now; they would need somewhere with larger bowls. Dema put the cloth wolf on the table and asked whether it counted.
pairs.hanzi: 他数了一遍人头，说今天先欠着，得找个碗大些的地方。德玛将布狼放到桌边，问这个算不算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu bǎ tā zhuǎnguò qù , jiào tā duì zhe pà wò nàbiān zhāngzuǐ , zhuōshàng de tāngsháo biàn yòu xiǎng chéng yípiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi turned it toward Pavo, telling it to open its mouth that way, and the table’s soup spoons rang out again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手把它转过去，叫它对着帕沃那边张嘴，桌上的汤勺便又响成一片。
